note: Pins the sha256 of each frozen bank / prompt set / grader watched by eval-ci. A bank edited without updating its pin here is a SILENT edit and MUST fail the PR (see check_bank.py). Updating a pin is a visible, reviewable diff that declares the change and triggers a re-run + delta card.

banks.note: Third-party published evaluation results converted into EvaluationResult/v1. Pinned so a silent edit to the corpus fails the PR. The corpus is a set of candidates: n_valid of them carry every required pin, the rest are recorded with the pins their publisher does not publish. Nothing in it is signed and nothing in it is a grade.

graders.name: behaviour-class-judge
graders.note: The grader is code; its pin is the file it lives in. A grader change is a declared edit and re-runs the axis.
